setting_unknown_summary: This entry is outside the app’s current settings catalog.
setting_unknown_help: This entry was found in the saved configuration or environment, but this version has no registered description or accepted-value rules for it. It may come from an older version or an external component. Its presence does not confirm that the current analysis uses it. Configure Jury 1 and Jury 2 through their buttons in Analysis, and use the named controls in Settings for the other available options.
setting_application_language_summary: Choose the language used for the app interface and built-in guides.
setting_application_language_help: The choice saves automatically. The selected language takes effect the next time you launch Callimachus.
setting_institutional_prompt_summary: Restores the institutional-access prompt for the next new analysis.
setting_institutional_prompt_help: Use this if you previously chose not to be asked about institutional access. The prompt will appear when you start the next new analysis. This does not remove saved browser profiles, cookies, or sign-in credentials.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_ACCURACY_summa: Sets how much source text Verify requires before it assesses whether a citation supports a claim.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_ACCURACY_help: Maximum requires full text, while Maximum with abstract fallback can assess an abstract provisionally when source existence is unknown. Standard prefers full text and uses abstracts for paywalls, Abstract checks abstracts only, and Standard web adds web research as a last resort.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_MAILTO_summary: Adds your contact address to requests sent to Crossref, Europe PMC, and Unpaywall.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_MAILTO_help: Enter an email address such as name@example.org. It is included in request headers for provider etiquette and rate limits, and is not written to the report; leaving it blank may reduce service limits.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_TABLE_C: Includes citations found only in manuscript tables among the claims sent for verification.
Enable this when table-only citations matter to your review. Many table cells contain data rather than claims, so enabling it can add items that need assessment.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_BACKEND: Selects the registered providers available to judge citation evidence, in preference order.
Enter provider IDs separated by commas, for example openai, gemini, or codex_cli. At least one provider is required for Verify, and each selected lane must have usable model and access settings.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_JURY2_L: Sets when Jury 2 reviews Jury 1 and how their disagreement affects the result.

Off disables the second judge. Low can retain Jury 1's result with a reliability downgrade; Medium retries within the candidate budget and then accepts only a Jury 1 majority, otherwise marking the pair uncertain. High uses the same retry path but marks an exhausted disagreement uncertain instead of accepting a majority.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_MODEL_summary: Provides model identifiers when a selected provider has no provider-specific model list.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_MODEL_help: Enter one or more comma-separated model IDs. A provider-specific model selection takes precedence; the selected provider must support the chosen ID.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_MAX_IN_: Caps how many verification requests may be in progress across all selected lanes.
Enter a positive whole number; the default is 4. A higher cap allows more requests to overlap and can use more provider capacity, while a lower cap limits parallel load.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_MAX_TOK: Sets the output-token budget for each model request.

Enter a positive whole number. Tokens are small units of text and do not always correspond to whole words. A higher budget allows longer responses and can increase provider usage; a lower budget can leave a response without enough room to finish.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_REASONING_summ: Requests automatic, enabled, or disabled reasoning where the selected provider supports it.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_REASONING_help: Choose Automatic, Enabled, or Disabled. Providers expose different controls, so unsupported reasoning options are omitted from their requests.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_REASONING_EFFO: Requests a low, medium, or high reasoning effort from compatible model providers.
Choose an effort level supported by the selected provider. Providers that do not expose a compatible control ignore this request.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_MAX_CAN: Limits Jury 1 candidate rounds for each claim-evidence pair.

Enter a positive whole-number limit; the default is 5. Each round admits a candidate or ends with a mechanical rejection; technical request failures do not use a round. A higher limit can allow more candidate rounds and add model requests and elapsed time.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_JURY1_M: Sets the per-stage cap on technical requests during each Jury 1 candidate round.

Enter a positive whole number; the default is 3. The total for each flow stage includes its first request, so 1 allows no additional technical retry. The cap applies separately to every stage within each candidate round; a higher value can extend runtime, while semantic disagreement is not retried.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_JURY2_M: Caps total technical requests for one Jury 2 candidate review.

Enter a positive whole number; the default is 3. The total includes the first request, so 1 allows no additional technical retry. A higher cap can extend runtime; semantic disagreement is not retried.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_JURY1_O: Restricts selected provider and model lanes to Jury 1.

Enter comma-separated selectors in the form provider:model, matching configured lanes exactly. Each listed lane is excluded from Jury 2; leave blank to allow all eligible lanes unless another restriction applies.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_JURY2_O: Restricts selected provider and model lanes to Jury 2.

Enter comma-separated selectors in the form provider:model, matching configured lanes exactly. Each listed lane is excluded from Jury 1 and cannot overlap the Jury 1-only list; leave blank for no restriction.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_LANG_summa: Sets the OCR languages used to read scanned manuscripts and cited PDFs.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_LANG_help: Enter OCR language codes such as eng or eng+ita. Use codes supported by the available OCR language data; join multiple codes with +.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_AUTO_summa: Recognizes cited PDFs automatically when their extracted text is too short.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_AUTO_help: When enabled, low-text cited PDFs are sent through OCR automatically. Turn it off to require an explicit OCR task instead; the page limit below controls which PDFs qualify.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_AUTO_MAX_P: Caps the number of PDF pages eligible for unattended automatic OCR.

Enter a page count of at least 1; the default is 50, and values below 1 are treated as 1. Raising the limit makes longer PDFs eligible and can add processing time; PDFs above it may need a manual OCR task.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_WORKERS_su: Sets how many OCR jobs can run at the same time across the application.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OCR_WORKERS_he: Enter a positive whole number; the default and minimum are 1. More workers can use more memory and processor capacity, and may not make OCR finish sooner with every backend.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_CONTEXT: Chooses how source text is selected and supplied to the verification models.

Automatic follows the context profile: Large uses full text, while Medium and Small use bounded extractive selection. Full text supplies available extracted text directly; Extractive RAG selects passages from the source and requires a positive character budget.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_CONTEXT_PROFIL: Sets the size of the source context used by Verify when its mode is Automatic.

In Automatic mode, Large uses full text; Medium and Small require extractive selection and a positive character budget. Smaller profiles use a narrower context and may omit relevant passages; in other modes, the selected mode controls the context method.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_MAX_SOURCE_CHA: Sets a positive character limit for source text admitted to Verify.

Enter a positive number of characters; zero is invalid. This value is required for Extractive RAG and Automatic with Medium or Small, but may be blank for Full text or Automatic with Large; a smaller budget can exclude source passages.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_PACING_: Sets the delay in milliseconds between starts of verification requests across lanes.
Enter a non-negative number of milliseconds; 0 means no configured delay. A larger interval spaces requests farther apart and can reduce request bursts while extending the run.
Sets an optional request-start delay in milliseconds for individual provider and model lanes.
Enter comma-separated mappings such as provider:model=250. Values are non-negative milliseconds; 0 adds no delay for that lane, while larger values space its requests farther apart.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_SELECTI: Sets the seed used to choose provider, credential, and model candidates reproducibly.
Enter a fixed seed to make candidate selection repeatable under the same frozen policy. Leave blank to derive the seed from the run and its policy hash.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_VERIFY_COOLDOW: Sets the baseline pause in seconds after a provider reports rate limiting.
Enter a positive number of seconds; the default is 5. A longer baseline waits longer before retrying requests affected by throttling.
Sets optional rate-limit cooldowns in seconds for individual provider and model lanes.
Enter comma-separated mappings such as provider:model=30, using positive whole seconds and configured lanes. Leave blank to use the baseline cooldown for every lane.
Sets how quickly a lane's local cooldown grows after repeated rate limits.
Enter a positive whole-number multiplier; the default is 2. A larger multiplier increases local pauses more quickly when throttling continues.
Caps locally calculated provider cooldowns in seconds.
Enter a positive whole number of seconds; the default is 300. An explicit Retry-After duration supplied by a provider remains a lower bound and can exceed this local cap.
Sets how many post-cooldown technical successes are needed to learn a stable wait.

Enter a positive whole number; the default is 2. It counts technically successful requests for the same provider, key, and model after cooldown; a negative verification result still counts. A 429 resets the count, while other technical errors leave it unchanged; a higher value requires more successes before the last applied wait becomes the stable baseline.
setting_OPENAI_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to OpenAI models when that provider is selected.
setting_OPENAI_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your OpenAI account. It is used by the selected OpenAI route; account access and usage limits still apply.
setting_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_summary: Provides the primary credential for the Anthropic model service.
setting_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_help: Enter the API key for the Anthropic lane. The current readiness check requires this key when that provider is selected; the additional auth token field alone is not sufficient.
setting_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN_summary: Adds an Anthropic token for request transports that accept token authentication.
setting_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN_help: Some Anthropic-compatible transports accept a token in this field as an additional credential. Provider readiness still requires the primary Anthropic API key, so this value alone may not make the lane usable.
setting_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL_summary: Routes Anthropic model requests to a compatible API endpoint.
setting_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL_help: Enter a base HTTP or HTTPS address such as http://127.0.0.1:8082. Leave blank for the standard Anthropic service; a custom endpoint must support this provider's request format.
setting_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_summary: Selects the model candidates used by the Anthropic verification lane.
setting_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by Anthropic, separated by commas. Provider access and model availability determine which candidates can respond.
setting_GEMINI_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to the Google Gemini model service.
setting_GEMINI_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your Google AI account. It is used when the Gemini API provider is selected; account access and usage limits still apply.
setting_GEMINI_MODEL_summary: Selects the model candidates used by the Gemini API verification lane.
setting_GEMINI_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by Gemini, separated by commas. Provider access and model availability determine which candidates can respond.
setting_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_summary: Stores the credential used to authenticate requests routed through OpenRouter.
setting_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_help: Enter the API credential issued by OpenRouter. It is used when the OpenRouter provider is selected; the provider's account access, model availability, and usage limits apply.
setting_OPENROUTER_MODEL_summary: Selects the model candidates used by the OpenRouter verification lane.
setting_OPENROUTER_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs recognized by OpenRouter, separated by commas. The chosen IDs must be available to your OpenRouter account.
setting_TYPESAFE_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to the TypeSafe model service.
setting_TYPESAFE_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your TypeSafe account. It is required when the TypeSafe provider is selected; account access and model availability still apply.
setting_TYPESAFE_MODEL_summary: Pins the versioned TypeSafe model used by its verification lane.
setting_TYPESAFE_MODEL_help: Enter a versioned model ID such as jev-1.13.0. Unversioned identifiers are rejected so the run uses a specific model version.
setting_TYPESAFE_MIN_CONFIDENCE_summary: Sets TypeSafe's minimum confidence for issuing an automatic decision.
setting_TYPESAFE_MIN_CONFIDENCE_help: Enter a value greater than 0 and at most 1; the default is 0.8. This is an auto-action floor, not the probability that a citation is correct. Responses below it abstain without a technical retry, and a higher floor makes fewer responses eligible for a decision.
setting_OLLAMA_API_KEY_summary: Provides authentication when the configured Ollama service requires a key.
setting_OLLAMA_API_KEY_help: The standard loopback Ollama route is keyless. Enter a credential only when the configured Ollama service requires authenticated access, such as a cloud route.
setting_OLLAMA_HOST_summary: Sets the server address used for Ollama model requests.
setting_OLLAMA_HOST_help: Enter the base URL of the Ollama service, including its scheme and port. The address must be reachable and expose an API supported by this provider.
setting_OLLAMA_MODEL_summary: Selects the model used by the Ollama verification lane.
setting_OLLAMA_MODEL_help: Enter a model identifier available from the configured Ollama service. The service must have that model available when Verify runs.
setting_FREETOKEN_HOST_summary: Sets the server address for the FreeToken model service.
setting_FREETOKEN_HOST_help: Enter the server root URL without a trailing /v1 path, for example http://127.0.0.1:1919. The server must already be reachable and expose the expected OpenAI-compatible API.
setting_FREETOKEN_MODEL_summary: Selects the model used by the FreeToken verification lane.
setting_FREETOKEN_MODEL_help: Enter a model ID exposed by the configured FreeToken server. The server must list or accept that model when Verify runs.
setting_FREETOKEN_API_KEY_summary: Provides authentication for a FreeToken server that requires a key.
setting_FREETOKEN_API_KEY_help: Leave blank for a keyless loopback service. Enter a credential only if the configured server requires authenticated access; the server's access rules still apply.
setting_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_summary: Selects the model used by the Claude Code verification lane.
setting_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_help: Enter a model identifier available to your existing Claude Code account. The lane uses that account's access and model availability.
setting_CODEX_CLI_MODEL_summary: Selects the model used by the Codex verification lane.
setting_CODEX_CLI_MODEL_help: Enter a model identifier available to your existing Codex account. The lane uses that account's access and model availability.
setting_GEMINI_CLI_MODEL_summary: Pins the model used by the Gemini account verification lane.
setting_GEMINI_CLI_MODEL_help: Enter an exact model ID supported by the signed-in Gemini account. This account-based route is separate from the Gemini API key provider.
setting_ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_MODEL_summary: Selects the model used by the Antigravity account verification lane.
setting_ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_MODEL_help: Enter a model identifier available to the existing Antigravity account. The lane depends on that account's access and supported model list.
setting_OPENCODE_CLI_MODEL_summary: Pins a model from the existing OpenCode account for verification.
setting_OPENCODE_CLI_MODEL_help: Enter an exact provider/model ID returned by the provider check. This uses the saved OpenCode account route and is separate from OpenCode Zen API access.
setting_OPENAI_BASE_URL_summary: Routes OpenAI-compatible model requests to a selected API endpoint.
setting_OPENAI_BASE_URL_help: Leave blank to use the standard OpenAI service, or enter a compatible base URL such as https://api.deepseek.com. A custom endpoint changes where requests are sent and must support the expected chat API.
setting_OPENAI_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for the OpenAI or compatible verification lane.
setting_OPENAI_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by the selected endpoint, separated by commas. The endpoint and your account determine which model IDs are available.
setting_ZHIPUAI_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to the GLM-compatible model service.
setting_ZHIPUAI_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by ZhipuAI or z.ai. It is used when the GLM provider is selected; account access and usage limits still apply.
setting_ZHIPUAI_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for the GLM verification lane.
setting_ZHIPUAI_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by the GLM service, separated by commas. The account and service determine which candidates can respond.
setting_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to DeepSeek independently of OpenAI.
setting_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_help: Enter the API key issued by DeepSeek. This credential is used only for the DeepSeek provider; its account access, model availability and usage limits apply.
setting_DEEPSEEK_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for DeepSeek verification.
setting_DEEPSEEK_MODEL_help: Choose available models from the checked DeepSeek catalogue, or enter model IDs accepted by your account, separated by commas.
setting_GROQ_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to Groq independently of OpenAI.
setting_GROQ_API_KEY_help: Enter the API key issued by Groq. This credential is used only for the Groq provider; its account access, model availability and usage limits apply.
setting_GROQ_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for Groq verification.
setting_GROQ_MODEL_help: Choose available models from the checked Groq catalogue, or enter model IDs accepted by your account, separated by commas.
setting_XAI_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates Grok requests through xAI independently of OpenAI and Groq.
setting_XAI_API_KEY_help: Enter the API key issued by xAI. This credential is used only for the xAI provider; its account access, model availability and usage limits apply.
setting_XAI_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for Grok verification through xAI.
setting_XAI_MODEL_help: Choose available models from the checked xAI language-model catalog, or enter model IDs accepted by your account, separated by commas.
setting_MISTRAL_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates requests to the Mistral model service.
setting_MISTRAL_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your Mistral account. It is used when the Mistral provider is selected; account access and usage limits still apply.
setting_MISTRAL_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for the Mistral verification lane.
setting_MISTRAL_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by Mistral, separated by commas. The account and service determine which candidates can respond.
setting_OPENCODE_API_KEY_summary: Authenticates API requests to the OpenCode Zen model service.
setting_OPENCODE_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for OpenCode Zen. API access requires an account with active billing; the account's available models and usage limits apply.
setting_OPENCODE_MODEL_summary: Selects model candidates for the OpenCode Zen verification lane.
setting_OPENCODE_MODEL_help: Enter one or more model IDs accepted by OpenCode Zen, separated by commas. The account and service determine which candidates can respond.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_LLM_HOST_COMMA: Routes model requests through a configured host integration.

The integration receives a JSON request and must return its response through the expected input and output streams. Keep authentication in the integration's own credential handling instead of embedding long-lived secrets in this command. This check validates the command and model IDs; the response is checked before a run.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OPENROUTER_SIT: Sets the optional site address sent to OpenRouter as request attribution.
Enter the public site address you want OpenRouter to associate with requests. Leave blank to omit the site attribution value.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OPENROUTER_APP: Sets the optional application name sent to OpenRouter as request attribution.
Enter the application name you want OpenRouter to associate with requests. Leave blank to omit the application-name attribution value.
setting_GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY_summary: Enables the optional book-preview retrieval tier from Google Books.
setting_GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your Google Books project. It enables opt-in preview snippets for books; leaving it blank disables this preview tier.
setting_CORE_API_KEY_summary: Enables CORE open-access discovery and direct API full-text retrieval.
setting_CORE_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by CORE. It enables open-access discovery and direct API full text when this source route is used; available records depend on CORE.
setting_ZENODO_ACCESS_TOKEN_summary: Enables a conservative Zenodo publication-copy fallback after version-of-record and open-access lookup.
setting_ZENODO_ACCESS_TOKEN_help: Enter a Zenodo token to allow this fallback route to check publication copies after the primary record and open-access lookup. The returned copy still has to pass the system's source-identity checks.
setting_ELSEVIER_API_KEY_summary: Enables Elsevier article retrieval by DOI or PII when the account has full-text entitlement.
setting_ELSEVIER_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued for your Elsevier account. Full-text retrieval also depends on the account's entitlement to the article; a key alone does not grant access.
setting_TDM_API_TOKEN_summary: Enables DOI-targeted PDF retrieval for catalog-routed Wiley works.
setting_TDM_API_TOKEN_help: Enter the Wiley text-and-data-mining token for this retrieval route. Wiley still checks access entitlement, including its IP-based requirements, before providing a PDF.
setting_SPRINGER_NATURE_META_API_KEY_sum: Adds metadata enrichment for catalog-routed works identified by DOI.
setting_SPRINGER_NATURE_META_API_KEY_hel: Enter the credential issued by Springer Nature. It enriches records already routed through the catalog and identified by DOI; it does not by itself establish source identity.
setting_SPRINGER_NATURE_OPEN_ACCESS_API_: Enables DOI-exact retrieval of open-access JATS full text from Springer Nature.
Enter the credential issued by Springer Nature for its open-access API. Retrieval is limited to the DOI-matched open-access work and depends on the service's availability.
setting_NCBI_API_KEY_summary: Raises the shared NCBI E-utilities request allowance from 3 to 10 requests per second.
setting_NCBI_API_KEY_help: Enter an NCBI API key to use the higher shared E-utilities rate of 10 requests per second. Without a key, NCBI's keyless limit is 3 requests per second.
setting_ENTREZ_API_KEY_summary: Accepts the NCBI E-utilities credential under its alternate name.
setting_ENTREZ_API_KEY_help: Enter the same kind of NCBI E-utilities API key here if you use this alternate field. It enables the keyed request rate; the higher allowance is shared across NCBI requests.
setting_OPENALEX_API_KEY_summary: Enables authenticated OpenAlex requests during source resolution and retrieval.
setting_OPENALEX_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by OpenAlex. It is optional and is used for authenticated OpenAlex requests when that source is consulted.
setting_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY_summary: Enables Semantic Scholar as an optional title-search fallback during resolution.
setting_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by Semantic Scholar to enable its title-search fallback. Without a key, this optional provider stands down and other configured lookup routes may continue.
setting_LENS_API_KEY_summary: Enables Lens.org as an optional title-search fallback during resolution.
setting_LENS_API_KEY_help: Enter the scholarly API token issued by Lens.org. Without a token, its optional title-search fallback is unavailable and other configured lookup routes may continue.
setting_BIBLIO_GLUTTON_URL_summary: Adds a local or self-hosted bibliographic resolver to source matching.
setting_BIBLIO_GLUTTON_URL_help: Enter the resolver's HTTP or HTTPS base URL, for example http://localhost:8080. Leave blank to disable this option; there is no public-demo fallback.
setting_COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN_summary: Enables checks that confirm cited United States cases from their reporter citations.
setting_COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN_help: Enter the API token issued by CourtListener. It lets Resolve check whether a United States case exists from its reporter citation; without it, this case-law check is skipped.
setting_TAVILY_API_KEY_summary: Enables Tavily as an optional search provider in the configured lookup chain.
setting_TAVILY_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by Tavily if its search route is enabled. Without a key, that route stands down and the configured chain may continue to another provider.
setting_MOJEEK_API_KEY_summary: Enables Mojeek as an optional search provider in the configured lookup chain.
setting_MOJEEK_API_KEY_help: Enter the credential issued by Mojeek if its search route is enabled. Without a key, that route stands down and the configured chain may continue to another provider.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_REPORT_HTML_su: Controls whether Callimachus creates a standalone HTML report after the report gate passes.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_REPORT_HTML_he: When enabled, Callimachus generates the self-contained HTML report after the canonical report checks pass. Turn it off to skip this HTML output.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_SIGNING_KEY_FI: Selects the local key file used to create an integrity seal for generated audit reports.
Enter the path to the local signing-key file. Use Generate signing key in Settings to create a key through the app; the file must remain available for report sealing.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_DEBUG_RUN_summ: Forces detailed debug-event capture during the run.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_DEBUG_RUN_help: Enable this when diagnosing an unexpected run behavior. It records more diagnostic events for inspection; leave it off for routine runs.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_PERF_summary: Records timing measurements for the pipeline phases in the run's audit database.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_PERF_help: Enable this to see how long the pipeline phases take. It adds a timing record to the run for performance diagnosis.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_DB: Selects the local journal catalog used to match journal names and abbreviations to ISSNs.
Enter the path to a local SQLite journal catalog. A missing, invalid, or ambiguous catalog cannot supply a match; blank uses the standard catalog when it is available.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_AU: Allows an NLM-based journal catalog to refresh before Resolve when its snapshot expires.
When enabled, Callimachus creates or refreshes an NLM-backed catalog before Resolve after its lifetime expires. A non-NLM catalog is never overwritten; with this off, updates remain manual.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_TT: Sets how many days an NLM journal catalog snapshot remains current before an enabled refresh is due.
Enter a positive number of days; the default is 7. This lifetime matters when automatic refresh is enabled; a longer value means fewer scheduled refreshes.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_RESOLVER_COVERAGE_DB: Selects the local catalog of dated resolver-coverage observations by journal.

Enter the path to a local SQLite coverage catalog, or leave blank to use the app's default store. Fresh observations can support coverage checks; stale or failed observations do not strengthen resolver suspicion.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_RESOLVER_COVERAGE_TT: Sets how many days a journal-coverage observation remains current before refresh is needed.
Enter a positive number of days; the default is 30. Expired observations are refreshed before they can strengthen a coverage suspicion; a longer lifetime means less frequent refreshes.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_USER_AGENT_sum: Overrides the User-Agent identity sent with all HTTP requests.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_USER_AGENT_hel: Enter a truthful application name and contact route. Leave blank to use Callimachus's built-in versioned identity; this setting affects all outbound HTTP requests.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_HTTP_PROFILE_s: Chooses the plain or browser-like profile used for HTTP requests.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_HTTP_PROFILE_h: Choose Plain for the plain request profile or Browser-like for the browser-style profile. This setting is applied to outgoing HTTP retrieval requests.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_FETCH_CHALLENG: Controls how Fetch responds when a publisher page presents an access challenge.
Choose Off, Queue, or one of the interactive modes. Interactive modes require the supported browser dependencies and operator workflow; fallback choices allow an alternate retrieval route.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_INSTITUTIONAL_FETCH_: Allows Fetch to try institution access through a separate browser profile.

Turn this on to let Fetch use a persistent browser profile for institution sign-in. If a sign-in portal is set, it opens in the login window; otherwise choose a publisher page and navigate to its sign-in page. Access is checked when Fetch retrieves sources.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_INSTITUTIONAL_PROFIL: Names the saved browser profile used for institution sign-in.
Use a 1–48 character name with letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores; it must start with a letter or digit. The default is guided_fetch. Different names keep browser sessions separate.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_INSTITUTION_summary: Names the institution to select on publisher access pages.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_INSTITUTION_help: Enter the institution name as it appears in a publisher's access options. The app uses it to find and select the matching institution; if this field is blank, it cannot select one. The limit is 160 characters, and control characters are rejected.
setting_CALLIMACHUS_INSTITUTIONAL_LOGIN_: Sets an optional HTTPS address for the institution's sign-in portal.

Enter a stable HTTPS address without a username or password in the address. Addresses with temporary sign-in parameters are rejected. Leave it blank to choose a publisher page in the login window and navigate to its sign-in page.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_GUIDED_SEARCH_: Sets the search-engine URL used by Guided Fetch when no source address is available.

Enter a credential-free HTTP or HTTPS URL containing exactly one {query} placeholder, for example https://example.com/search?q={query}. Callimachus inserts the encoded search text there; an invalid template prevents that search from opening.
Sets the fields combined into searches opened by Guided Fetch for non-DOI references.

Use one or more supported placeholders, such as {raw_entry}, {title}, {doi}, {pmid}, {isbn}, {year}, {ay_surname}, or {source_type}. A recovered or parsed DOI is searched by itself instead of using this template.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_FETCH_PROVIDER: Chooses which known Fetch providers are included in automatic source retrieval.
Enter auto or a comma-separated subset of known provider names. The list filters the currently configured providers; it does not add new providers, and a blank value uses the default enabled set.
Sets the precedence order for the selected source-retrieval providers.
Enter a comma-separated list of configured provider names. This changes their order within the selected set; provider capability, availability, and host policy still apply.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_OA_ALTERNATES_: Controls the second retrieval round through alternate open-access candidates.
When enabled, Fetch checks alternate open-access candidates after its initial acquisition route. Disable it to skip that second round; it can add retrieval requests and time.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_WAYBACK_summar: Allows Fetch to look for source copies in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_WAYBACK_help: When enabled, Wayback is available as an archival acquisition route. Disable it to skip that route; archive availability depends on the source and the archive.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_PERMA_summary: Allows Fetch to look for source copies in Perma.cc archives.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_PERMA_help: When enabled, Perma.cc is available as an archival acquisition route. Disable it to skip that route; an archived copy may not exist for every source.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_FETCH_WORKERS_: Sets how many source retrievals can run at the same time.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 16; the default is 4. More retrievals at once may shorten longer analyses when target sites allow parallel requests, but they also increase concurrent load.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_RESOLVE_WORKER: Sets how many bibliography references Resolve can process at the same time.
Leave blank for bibliography-size-aware automatic scaling, or enter a fixed positive worker count. Higher fixed concurrency can increase parallel requests to lookup services.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_FETCH_PDF_TIME: Sets the download timeout in seconds for each PDF.
Enter seconds; the default is 45, and runtime clamps the value to 5–300 seconds. A longer timeout gives a slow PDF more time but keeps its retrieval worker occupied longer.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_FETCH_BUDGET_S: Sets how many seconds are available to retrieve each reference.

Enter seconds; the default is 120, and 0 means unlimited. A higher budget gives each reference more time for source retrieval but can lengthen the analysis. When the budget expires, remaining retrieval routes are skipped and the source can be tried again later.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_HTTP_MEMO_summ: Reuses identical read-only HTTP GET results within a single run.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_HTTP_MEMO_help: When enabled, repeated identical API GET requests in the run can use the saved response instead of repeating the request. The reuse lasts only for that run and does not apply to other request types.
jury_provider_directory_help: Choose a provider to configure and select its models.
jury_provider_no_settings: No additional configuration is required for this provider.
jury_advanced_scope: Settings shared by the whole analysis, for both Juries.
atlas_empty_library: Your library is empty. Import papers to get started.
atlas_find_latest: Find and resume the latest analysis in the background.
atlas_severity_hint: Controls how Jury 2 handles uncertain responses.
atlas_parse_hint: Only when there are citations or references to review.
atlas_fetch_hint: Automatic retrieval stays active when this option is off. Incomplete sources remain unverified.
atlas_institution_hint: Sign in to multiple publishers using the saved browser session.
atlas_library_help: Filter saved sources by the text available for verification.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_STATE_DIR_summ: Location for the Library and persistent caches. Leave empty for the default folder.
setting_CITATION_VERIFIER_STATE_DIR_help: Choose where Callimachus stores reusable texts and local data. This field does not move existing archives.
atlas_source_detail_empty: Select a source to see its details.
atlas_source_detail_lazy: The preview loads when you request it.
atlas_settings_summary: Application preferences and source services. Configure models from the Jury chooser.
guided_fetch_capture_hint: Capture from the assisted Chrome toolbar.
guided_fetch_browser_toolbar_pending: Waiting for the publisher page. Complete any check in Chrome; capture controls will appear when ready.
guided_fetch_proceed_question: Proceed with the available sources and skip every remaining retrieval? Any identity review that becomes available for sources added during this Fetch will also be skipped, and those sources will remain unverified. Skipped sources will be recorded as waived and unavailable for verification. No source text will be inferred or created.
guided_fetch_proceed_identity_question: Proceed with available sources and skip every remaining retrieval? Pending identity reviews for sources {source_numbers}, and any identity review that becomes available for sources added during this Fetch, will be skipped; those sources will remain unverified. Remaining retrievals will be recorded as waived and unavailable for verification. No source text will be inferred or created.
jury_provider_shared_scope: Shared configuration for Jury 1 and Jury 2.
jury_host_integration_hint: Advanced connection to a local command, not an API service. Configure CITATION_VERIFIER_LLM_HOST_COMMAND before starting Callimachus and enable the host backend. The command must accept a JSON request on standard input and return the model response on standard output. Use the dedicated provider entries for supported services.
jury_provider_shared: Selections from other providers are kept. Credentials and endpoints are shared; Jury model selections are independent.
jury_endpoint_hint: Leave empty for the standard service.
jury_freetoken_api_key_hint: Leave blank if your FreeToken server does not require authentication.
jury_freetoken_catalog_idle: Press Check to load the models available from FreeToken.
jury_freetoken_catalog_checking: Checking FreeToken and loading its catalogue…
jury_freetoken_catalog_error: The catalogue is unavailable. Review the error below and retry with Check.
jury_freetoken_catalog_stale: Configuration changed. Press Check to refresh the catalogue.
jury_freetoken_catalog_empty: FreeToken responded but returned no available models.
jury_cli_configuration_hint: Uses the account configured in the local application. Check installation and available models with Check.
jury_fixed_service_hint: This provider uses its configured service.
guided_fetch_filter_tooltip: Show sources by text availability or identity review
guided_fetch_cloudflare_notice: Automatic retrieval encountered a Cloudflare challenge for this source. The assisted browser may not complete it; use the system browser instead, then provide the acquired file in Callimachus.
guided_fetch_no_sources_match: No sources match the selected filter.
guided_fetch_instructions_tooltip: Open instructions for providing and confirming a source
guided_fetch_source_tier_tooltip: Specify whether the file contains full text or only an abstract
guided_fetch_continue_tooltip: Continue with available sources and keep every unresolved retrieval waived.
guided_fetch_identity_operator_required: This process is agent-identified: a separately authenticated human operator must submit the identity decision.
guided_fetch_identity_refresh_failed: The identity decision was recorded, but this view could not be refreshed. Close and reopen Guided Fetch to continue.
guided_fetch_identity_note_placeholder: Optional note for this identity decision
guided_fetch_identity_confirm: Confirm: this is the cited work
guided_fetch_identity_pending_guidance: Sources {numbers} still need an identity decision. Proceed can record them as unverified after your confirmation.
guided_fetch_identity_pending_tooltip: After confirmation, record sources {numbers} as identity unverified, then waive every remaining retrieval.
guided_fetch_identity_agent_blocked: This agent-identified session cannot submit source identity reviews. A separately authenticated human operator must record the pending identity decision before Proceed is available.
guided_fetch_identity_submission_unavail: This session has no identity-review submission action. Reopen Guided Fetch through the operator-controlled Fetch workflow to record the review.
guided_fetch_pending_ocr_admission: OCR text staged · pending Fetch checks; not admitted
guided_fetch_pending_source_admission: Provided source queued · pending Fetch checks; not admitted
guided_fetch_staged_ocr_message: This OCR text is staged and pending Fetch checks; it is not an admitted source.
guided_fetch_staged_ocr_status: Staged OCR text; pending Fetch checks and not admitted for verification.
guided_fetch_staged_source_message: This provided file is queued pending Fetch checks; it has not been admitted as evidence.
guided_fetch_staged_source_status: Provided source is queued pending Fetch checks and is not admitted for verification.
guided_fetch_action_guidance_fulltext: Full text is already available. No action is required unless the acquired document is visibly the wrong work.
guided_fetch_action_guidance_review_labe: Review labels: {labels}. They are informational only and not proof of fabrication. Inspect the recorded evidence, then supply only a captured file for the exact cited work; otherwise leave it pending and use Proceed / skip remaining.
guided_fetch_action_guidance_abstract: Callimachus currently has an abstract. Supply only a captured file for the exact cited work. If you cannot verify it, leave it pending and use Proceed / skip remaining; it will remain unavailable for verification.
guided_fetch_action_guidance_no_text: Callimachus currently has no usable text. Supply only a captured file for the exact cited work. If you cannot verify it, leave it pending and use Proceed / skip remaining; it will remain unavailable for verification.
guided_fetch_pdf_check_queued_detail: {source} is waiting for its PDF readability check.
guided_fetch_pdf_check_cancel_tooltip: Cancel this reference's PDF readability check and discard its result.
guided_fetch_pdf_check_running_note: You can continue searching while this PDF check runs.
guided_fetch_queued_ocr_done_detail: {source} captured/selected and queued; OCR text extracted.
guided_fetch_queued_ocr_pending_detail: {source} captured/selected and queued; OCR is required before its text can be assessed.
guided_fetch_queued_readable_detail: {source} captured/selected and queued; readability checked before Proceed.
source_contact_explanation: No source-search service keys or contact email are configured. Would you like to add an email to assist Resolve and, where supported, speed up requests? It will be used in service API calls, not to register an account. It is optional and does not guarantee access to source texts.
source_contact_save_failed: Could not save the email. Retry or continue without it.
source_contact_load_failed: Could not read the source-service configuration.
browser_cache_help: Clears navigation caches for browsers managed by Callimachus. Keeps cookies, login sessions and acquired texts.
browser_cache_cleared: Browser cache cleared. Login sessions and acquired texts were preserved.
browser_cache_deferred: Cache cleanup incomplete: some data is in use or inaccessible. Retry after closing the browser.
settings_backup_note: Export, import or reset preferences, services and Jury choices. Runs, reports and acquired texts are kept.
settings_export_note: The file includes configured API keys and endpoints. Protect it with a password or explicitly choose to export it as plain text.
settings_import_note: This replaces the current configuration. Available fields are imported; new or missing fields use current defaults.
settings_reset_note: Restore default settings? Jury selections will also be cleared. You may keep API keys and their endpoints or remove everything.
settings_encrypt: Encrypt the file with a password
settings_password_warning: The password is never saved. If you lose it, the encrypted file cannot be recovered. Use a long, unique password. A plain-text file exposes API keys.
settings_password_invalid: Use at least 6 characters and repeat the same password.
settings_keep_keys: Keep API keys and provider endpoints
settings_transfer_busy: Wait for the run or service check to finish before replacing settings.
settings_transfer_failed: Could not complete the operation. Check the file, password and access permissions.
search_custom_required: Enter a valid address for the custom search engine.
api_key_recheck: Key verified. Click to check it again.
settings_import_encrypted_note: This file is encrypted. Enter its password to replace the current configuration. Available fields are imported; new or missing fields use current defaults.
language_restart_question: Restart Callimachus to apply the new language? Your selection has been saved. You can also restart later.
language_restart_failed: Callimachus could not restart. Your language selection is saved; close and reopen the app to apply it.
library_reason_unreadable_file: The document did not contain readable text for verification.
library_reason_staged_file_missing: The reviewed document copy is unavailable. Import the document again.
library_reason_staged_file_changed: The reviewed document changed after import. Import it again before saving.
library_reason_identity_file_mismatch: The retrieved details did not confirm the identity of this document. Check its opening text and the selected identifier.
library_reason_source_format_conflict: Identical file bytes were supplied with conflicting formats. Check the file extensions and import the document again.
credential_recovery_body: Import saved API keys into one Keychain entry? macOS may ask once for each old key: choose “Always Allow”. Cancel to continue without them.
credential_recovery_incomplete: Some credentials remain unavailable. You can continue without them or configure the required services in Settings.
export_historical_report_saved: Redacted historical report exported. The original analysis was not revalidated.
guided_fetch_proceed_short: Continue with the available sources? Remaining retrievals will be skipped and unresolved identities will stay unverified.
